# Antara

> Antara Wellness is a wellbeing companion for iOS and Android, a product of Antara Innovations. She remembers you across four modules (Talk, Reflect, Heal, Elevate), can talk face to face with a live digital face, and keeps a plain-words memory you can read and delete. She is not a clinician or a crisis service.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://www.antara.icu/): what Antara is and how it works
- [How it works](https://www.antara.icu/product/): the Antara loop and how the modules share one memory
- [For clinics and organisations](https://www.antara.icu/partners/): pilots with clinics, workplaces, universities and public programmes
- [Privacy](https://www.antara.icu/privacy/)
- [Support](https://www.antara.icu/support/)

## Facts
- Apps: App Store (id6755032385) and Google Play (com.antara.health)
- Made by Antara Innovations: https://www.antara-innovations.com/
- Not a medical service. In an emergency, contact local emergency services.
